title: Bond thickenings of the simplicial boundary of Outer space
summary: We study the simplicial boundary $\partial\mathcal{FS}$ of Culler-Vogtmann Outer space via thickenings defined by graph-theoretic connectivity. Let $C'$ be the subcomplex of the free splitting complex obtained from $\partial\mathcal{FS}$ by adding all stable graphs that are not $3$-edge connected, together with their faces. We prove that the inclusion $\partial\mathcal{FS}\hookrightarrow C'$ is $(2n-3)$-connected.
